name: Hawker 4000
summary: Raytheon's all-composite, long-range super-midsize jet, a small-production type with a heavily swept wing.

wings: Low, strongly swept wing with plain tips
engines: Two Pratt & Whitney Canada PW308A turbofans in pods on the rear fuselage
fuselage: Long, slim, smooth composite fuselage with large oval windows
tail: T-tail with a swept fin and a large swept stabilizer

tellTales: Heavily swept wing with no winglets on a modern T-tail jet
Long, smooth, slim fuselage with large oval windows
Rear pods and a tall T-tail

confusedWith.howToTell: The Challenger 300 has upturned winglets and a longer tapering tail cone; the Hawker 4000 has plain wingtips.
The G280 has large winglets and oval windows; the Hawker 4000 has plain tips.
The Falcon 2000 has a cruciform tail with the stabilizer partway up the fin; the Hawker 4000 has a true T-tail.
The Hawker 800 has a cruciform tail with a dorsal fillet and a straighter wing; the Hawker 4000 has a T-tail and a more heavily swept wing.
